assertions.text: Output contains a markdown table (using | column | syntax)
assertions.evidence: | Scenario | Applicant Age | Credit Score | Min Score (Policy) | Stable Income | Approved? | Rejection Reason? |

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Eligible?' or 'Approved?')
assertions.evidence: Column headers 'Approved?' and 'Rejection Reason?' both end with '?'

assertions.text: Column names use domain/business language — no implementation terms like 'creditScore', 'isEligible', 'boolean', 'int'
assertions.evidence: Column names are: Scenario, Applicant Age, Credit Score, Min Score (Policy), Stable Income, Approved?, Rejection Reason? — all business-friendly with no camelCase or technical terms

assertions.text: Table includes at least one row specifically for the senior applicant (65+) threshold scenario
assertions.evidence: Senior applicant, score at senior threshold (not above) | 65 | 600 | 600 | yes | no | Credit score not above 600

assertions.text: The missing income scenario is represented — either as a row with an open/uncertain expected value (?, TBD, or blank) or as an explicit open question note
assertions.evidence: Standard applicant, missing income info | 40 | 720 | 650 | | **?** | and Senior applicant, missing income info | 65 | 630 | 600 | | **?** | plus Open Questions section discussing missing income info

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions ('Senior applicant at threshold') not outcomes ('Approved')
assertions.evidence: All scenario names describe input conditions: 'Standard applicant, clear approval', 'Senior applicant, score just above senior threshold', 'Standard applicant, no stable income', 'Senior applicant, missing income info' — none describe outcomes

assertions.text: The policy thresholds (650 for standard, 600 for senior) appear as concrete values in the Credit Score column — not just described in prose. The reader can see the boundary values in the table rows.
assertions.evidence: Standard applicant, score at threshold (not above) | 40 | 650 | 650 and Senior applicant, score at senior threshold (not above) | 65 | 600 | 600 — threshold boundary values (650, 600) appear as concrete Credit Score values in specific rows
